source.note: Traveler (electro) — one character per element; both twins map here. Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets + allStat_gen skillParam at Lv10. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. Enka ingestion maps avatarId 10000005/10000007 + skillDepotId to this synthetic avatar_id. Unparsed GO formulas: ['burst.thirdThunderDmg: skipped (helper/cond formula)']. ADDITIONAL BUFF EFFECTS, added 2026-08-14: the quest-unlocked passive 'Foreign Thundertrail' (nanoka passives[].unlock [603101]; the stat list itself lives in the in-game glossary, nanoka hyperlink.json entry 10050001, NOT in the passive's own description) grants the Traveler one permanent stat bonus PER ELEMENT THEY HAVE RESONATED WITH: Anemo +10% CRIT Rate, Geo +20% DEF, Electro +20% Energy Recharge, Dendro +60 Elemental Mastery, Hydro +20% HP, Pyro +20% ATK, Cryo +20% CRIT DMG — the same seven values are param[0..6] of every Traveler's Foreign passive. All seven are seeded unconditionally in self_modifiers_json, i.e. ASSUMING A FULLY-RESONATED ACCOUNT: Enka exposes neither the resonance list nor whether the passive is unlocked, so there is nothing to gate on. (fightPropMap does include passive stat bonuses — Kokomi's -100% CRIT Rate shows up there — but the evaluator rebuilds stats from sources via build_base_stats_from_sources and never reads fightPropMap, which is why every unconditional passive stat effect has to be seeded like this.) NOT MODELLED: the same passive's special Charged Attack: Detonate (+100% ATK on each CA hit plus a delayed 200%-ATK lightning strike counted as Charged Attack DMG, once per 15s) — separate damage instances that would need their own hit definitions. QUEST BASE-STAT BONUSES, added 2026-08-14: base_stats_json above is deliberately NOT the raw game curve value. The Traveler carries three permanent quest rewards: +3 Base ATK from Activated Canned Knowledge (Archon Quest Ch. III Act I 'Ever So Close', step 5) and +7 Base ATK / +15 Elemental Mastery / +50 Base HP from Special Training in Skirk's Story Quest (Crystallina Ch. Act I, steps 2/6/9). So baseAtk 212.397192 -> 222.397192, baseHp 10874.914859 -> 10924.914859, and baseEleMas 15 (the only character in this seed set with a non-zero base EM). Verified against Enka: over all 338 level-90 builds in the local DB, the Traveler is the ONLY character whose fightPropMap base HP differs from its seed (by exactly +50.00), whose base-ATK residual exceeds weapon mainStatValue display rounding (+9.66), or whose EM carries an unexplained +15. These are flat and level-independent, so scale_base_stats_to_level will scale them by ~1.7% too much on a level-100 board (0.17 ATK / 0.85 HP) -- not worth a special case. DO NOT 'correct' these back to the nanoka/Amber curve values: the base-stat audit script will flag all seven travelers for exactly this.
